failureDescription: Browserbase session crashed due to DOM FrameDetachedError during iframe payment submission.

events.name: browserbase_click_payment_iframe
events.error: BrowserbaseProtocolError: Target.detachedFromTarget: Frame detached while waiting for selector #secure-pay-btn inside iframe.stripe-elements

events.name: session_execution_crash
events.error: UnhandledDOMException: FrameDetachedError terminating web automation run

hypothesis.title: Browserbase Tool Crash: FrameDetachedError in Payment Iframe
hypothesis.explanation: At evt_403 Browserbase attempted to click #secure-pay-btn in an iframe that re-rendered and detached from the DOM tree before the click event was dispatched.
hypothesis.suggestedFix: Implement waitForSelector with frame re-attachment recovery logic before clicking embedded checkout iframes.
